source.title: Primal Spark Pauldrons — live Wowhead Looter disenchant table
source.author: Wowhead Looter aggregated submissions

notes: Live WoWhead index reports exactly 9 base-item disenchant operations with TWO different same-name Dawn Crystal output rows; this is one aggregated base-item dataset, not two independent studies or nine validated raw cast logs. The selected URL's 266 item-level and heroic bonus parameters describe a VIEWED tooltip, NOT item-level/rarity/bonus of any disenchant operation. Epic mail shoulders by selectable tooltip only. The two output rows must not be mapped to guessed 243605/243606 ranks or collapsed, and positive per-material hits are NOT output quantities or a zero-inclusive overall-material cast histogram. PTR mirrors show identical 9/7/2 and must NOT count as additional samples. Hold as research-only reference until linked output identities and cast provenance are independently verified.
